question: For frozen AAI-11B intervention-contrast vs same-information graph_recent8, is poor achieved action reward caused mainly by imperfect causal law/rule predictions or by the shared action planner despite correct predictions?

mechanics.shared_training: 16 A +16 B common actual one-action trials =64 public initial+result rows, no law/boundary/privileged fields to learner
mechanics.challenge: C,D,E,F unfamiliar laws, 2 or 4 common exogenous actual one-action challenge trials =4 or 8 public rows
mechanics.contexts: 12 exact original AAI11P selected unique x/goal contexts per law,budget,fixture = 24 condition groups x12 =288 paired episodes
mechanics.evaluation: Independently cold restore each method per episode, issue public initial, 0-2 actual self-selected intervention actions, only own real do feedback. Never share between methods. All diagnostic oracle/private truth lives outside learner, never passed as learner observation.
mechanics.factual_probe: At each after-challenge frozen checkpoint score 64 binary inputs x 3 mediator bits per method against true hidden simulator structure via read-only simulator diagnostic; report overall and per mediator bit accuracy. No learning from probe x or true labels.
mechanics.intervention_probe: At each after-challenge checkpoint score all 64x12 do-actions; compare predicted causal mediator *flips* (3 bits) under setting x_i=v with actual counterfactual simulator flip, for each method. Probe private only and NEVER train learner or reward during episodes. Report flip exact 3-bit fraction and per-bit fraction. All actions enumerated equally.
mechanics.selected_rules: Count selected candidate vs baseline graph rule-index disagreements, count public consecutive actual do-action flip pairs retained within last eight rows. Model caches may be filled by read-only probes but no durable model state changes; restore from unchanged serialized state afterward.
mechanics.action_regret: For each independent episode, capture achieved terminal public reward vs exact two-action known-law oracle; report reward regret and actual action counts, zero oracle results to learners.
mechanics.perfect_predictor_planner: Create diagnostic-only adapter whose predict(x) returns actual privileged true-law mediator bits; use the UNMODIFIED shared AAI11P controls.plan and public action execution with 0-2 steps on exactly the original contexts. Compare perfect-predictor planner mean to exact two-action brute-force oracle. This is diagnostic upper bound, not an eligible learner.
mechanics.matched_control_recheck: Recompute ONLY frozen graph_recent8, not 11 conventional controls; require its aggregate realized reward equals historical 2.134027778 within 1e-6 and candidate equals 2.084722222 within 1e-6; otherwise INVALID_PROVENANCE. The previous exact-source 11-control qualification remains the strongest-control evidence.
mechanics.no_new_science: Only frozen mechanical fixture strings; not original 16 DEV/64 TRANSFER/32 NEGATIVE world seeds; no new training candidate, model update or first use.

attribution.plane: Engineering diagnostic result, not causal experimental proof of model superiority or deep cognitive attribution.
decision_order: If oracle over perfect predictor's shared planner >0.05 mean terminal reward: PLANNER_LIMITATION_DETECTED, because even correct causal predictions do not recover oracle actions.
Else if candidate factual or intervention-flip prediction accuracy lower than control by >=.01 and candidate reward lower by >=.03: HYPOTHESIS_SELECTION_LIMIT_DIAGNOSTIC.
Else if candidate causal-prediction accuracies both >=control-.01 and candidate reward lower by >=.03: POLICY_OR_CALIBRATION_MISMATCH_DIAGNOSTIC.
attribution.caveat: Each method's own actions generate different subsequent observations and therefore different learning; no claim that pure prediction-vs-action causality is identified from this comparison alone. Perfect predictor is privileged reference only, never a learner. Results source-only synthetic, no confidence intervals.

artifact.metrics: Printed deterministic JSON with complete state/action/probe digest and aggregate rates per method; no user Library artifacts
artifact.tests: Negative secret law injection, identical source checkpoints, frozen shared planner, perfect model upper bound, actual public intervention counts and cold independence, cohort disarm

stop: No learner tuning nor new scientific first-use even if diagnosis suggests actionable next hypothesis; a novel mechanism requires a separate prereg before code.
